from math import floor
MOD = 998244353

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    m = int(input[1])
    L = int(input[2])
    R = int(input[3])

    k = R - L + 1

    if (n * m) % 2 == 1:
        exponent = n * m
        base = k
        result = pow(base, exponent, MOD)
        print(result)
    else:
        eCount = R // 2 - (L - 1) // 2
        oCount = k - eCount
        E = eCount
        O = oCount
        exp = n * m
        sum_pow = pow(E + O, exp, MOD)
        diff_pow = pow(E - O, exp, MOD)
        result = ((sum_pow + diff_pow) * pow(2, -1, MOD)) % MOD
        print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
